title: token.create
description: Create new tokens. A token created by this method also has to be generated (token.generate) before it is usable.

name.description: Name of the token. Required for create operations.

userid.description: ID of the user that the token has been assigned to. Default: current user. Property behavior: constant (can be set on create but not changed afterwards).

status.description: Token status. Possible values: 0 - (default) enabled token; 1 - disabled token.

expires_at.description: Token expiration date and time. "0" for never-expiring tokens.
